sources.title: A 135M Pixel Model Beats Billion-Parameter Baselines
sources.snippet: At 135M parameters it reaches FID 2.58 on ImageNet 256×256, past the 3.60 of earlier billion-scale pixel-space AR. Scaled to 511M it drops to 1.94 — an order of magnitude fewer parameters and still better. The quality gap for this route is narrowing fast.
